003import org.lwjgl.util.vector.Vector2f;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.FleetAssignment;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.SectorEntityToken;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.ai.FleetAIFlags;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.ai.ModularFleetAIAPI;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.rules.MemoryAPI;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.characters.AbilityPlugin;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Abilities;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.MemFlags;
015import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.misc.SupportFleetIntel;
016import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.IntervalUtil;
017import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
018
019public class SustainedBurnAbilityAI extends BaseAbilityAI {
020
021        public static final float AI_FREQUENCY_MULT = 1f;
022        
023        private IntervalUtil interval = new IntervalUtil(0.05f, 0.15f);
024
025//      public EmergencyBurnAbilityAI(AbilityPlugin ability, ModularFleetAIAPI ai) {
026//              super(ability, ai);
027//      }
028
029        public void advance(float days) {
030                interval.advance(days * SustainedBurnAbilityAI.AI_FREQUENCY_MULT);
031                if (!interval.intervalElapsed()) return;
032                
033                MemoryAPI mem = fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
034                if (ability.isActiveOrInProgress()) {
035                        mem.set(FleetAIFlags.HAS_SPEED_BONUS, true, 0.2f);
036                        mem.set(FleetAIFlags.HAS_HIGHER_DETECTABILITY, true, 0.2f);
037                }
038                
039                boolean smuggler = mem.getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_SMUGGLER);
040                if (smuggler) {
041                        if (ability.isActive()) ability.deactivate();
042                        return;
043                }
044                
045                boolean playerSupportFleet = Misc.isPlayerSupportFleet(fleet) && 
046                                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(SupportFleetIntel.SUPPORT_FLEET_FOLLOW);
047                if (playerSupportFleet && fleet.isInCurrentLocation()) {
048                        CampaignFleetAPI player = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
049                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(player, fleet);
050                        AbilityPlugin sb = player.getAbility(Abilities.SUSTAINED_BURN);
051                        if (sb != null) {
052                                if (sb.isActive()) {
053                                        if (!ability.isActive()) ability.activate();
054                                } else if (!sb.isActive() && dist < 500f) {
055                                        if (ability.isActive()) ability.deactivate();
056                                }
057                        }
058                        return;
059                }
060                
061                
062                if (fleet.getAI() instanceof ModularFleetAIAPI) {
063                        ModularFleetAIAPI ai = (ModularFleetAIAPI) fleet.getAI();
064                        if (ai.getTacticalModule().isMaintainingContact()) {
065                                if (ability.isActive()) ability.deactivate();
066                                return;
067                        }
068                }
069                
070                if (mem.getBoolean(FleetAIFlags.HAS_LOWER_DETECTABILITY) && !ability.isActive()) {
071                        return;
072                }
073                
074//              if (true) {
075//                      if (!ability.isActive()) {
076//                              ability.activate();
077//                      } else {
078//                              ability.deactivate();
079//                      }
080//                      return;
081//              }
082//              if (fleet.getAI() != null && fleet.getAI().getCurrentAssignmentType() == FleetAssignment.STANDING_DOWN) {
083//                      return;
084//              }
085                
086                CampaignFleetAPI pursueTarget = mem.getFleet(FleetAIFlags.PURSUIT_TARGET);
087                CampaignFleetAPI fleeingFrom = mem.getFleet(FleetAIFlags.NEAREST_FLEEING_FROM);
088
089//              float moveDir = Misc.getDesiredMoveDir(fleet);
090                
091                float burn = Misc.getBurnLevelForSpeed(fleet.getVelocity().length());
092//              if (ability.isActive() && burn >= 5f) {
093//                      float diff = Misc.getAngleDiff(moveDir, Misc.getAngleInDegrees(fleet.getVelocity()));
094//                      if (diff > 90f) {
095//                              ability.deactivate();
096//                              return;
097//                      }
098//              }
099                
100                
101                float activationTime =  ability.getSpec().getActivationDays() * Global.getSector().getClock().getSecondsPerDay();
102                if (fleeingFrom != null) {
103                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(fleet.getLocation(), fleeingFrom.getLocation());
104                        float speed = Math.max(1f, fleeingFrom.getTravelSpeed());
105                        float time = dist / speed;
106                        if (!ability.isActive()) { // far enough to wind up and get away
107                                if (time >= activationTime + 5f) {
108                                        ability.activate();
109                                }
110                        } else { // too close to wind up, better chance of getting away by turning SB off
111                                if (burn <= 3 && time < 5f) {
112                                        ability.deactivate();
113                                }
114                        }
115                        return;
116                }
117                
118                if (pursueTarget != null) {
119//                      if (pursueTarget.isPlayerFleet()) {
120//                              System.out.println("fwefewwe");
121//                      }
122                        if (ability.isActive()) {
123                                float toTarget = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(fleet.getLocation(), pursueTarget.getLocation());
124                                float velDir = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(fleet.getVelocity());
125                                float diff = Misc.getAngleDiff(toTarget, velDir);
126                                if (diff > 60f) {
127                                        ability.deactivate();
128                                }
129                        }
130                        return;
131                }
132                
133                
134                if (fleet.getAI() != null && fleet.getAI().getCurrentAssignment() != null) {
135                         FleetAssignment curr = fleet.getAI().getCurrentAssignmentType();
136                         SectorEntityToken target = fleet.getAI().getCurrentAssignment().getTarget();
137                         boolean inSameLocation = target != null && target.getContainingLocation() == fleet.getContainingLocation();
138                         float distToTarget = 100000f;
139                         if (inSameLocation) {
140                                 distToTarget = Misc.getDistance(target.getLocation(), fleet.getLocation());
141                         }
142                         boolean close = distToTarget < 2000;
143                         
144                         if (close && 
145                                         (curr == FleetAssignment.ORBIT_PASSIVE ||
146                                          curr == FleetAssignment.ORBIT_AGGRESSIVE ||
147                                          curr == FleetAssignment.DELIVER_CREW ||
148                                          curr == FleetAssignment.DELIVER_FUEL ||
149                                          curr == FleetAssignment.DELIVER_MARINES ||
150                                          curr == FleetAssignment.DELIVER_PERSONNEL ||
151                                          curr == FleetAssignment.DELIVER_RESOURCES ||
152                                          curr == FleetAssignment.DELIVER_SUPPLIES ||
153                                          curr == FleetAssignment.RESUPPLY ||
154                                          curr == FleetAssignment.GO_TO_LOCATION ||
155                                          curr == FleetAssignment.GO_TO_LOCATION_AND_DESPAWN)
156                                          ) {
157                                 if (ability.isActive()) ability.deactivate();
158                                 return;
159                         }
160                         if (inSameLocation && (
161                                         curr == FleetAssignment.RAID_SYSTEM ||
162                                         curr == FleetAssignment.PATROL_SYSTEM)) {
163                                 if (ability.isActive()) ability.deactivate();
164                                 return;
165                         }
166                }
167                
168                
169                Vector2f travelDest = mem.getVector2f(FleetAIFlags.TRAVEL_DEST);
170                if (travelDest != null) {
171                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(fleet.getLocation(), travelDest);
172                        float speed = Math.max(1f, fleet.getTravelSpeed());
173                        float time = dist / speed;
174                        if (!ability.isActive()) {
175                                if (time > activationTime * 2f) {
176                                        ability.activate();
177                                }
178                        }
179                        return;
180                }
181                
182                
183                
184        }
185        
186        
187}
